experiments.title: ER / EER design
experiments.application: Region → Weather_Station → Sensor → Sensor_Reading represents the observation path. Forecast → Heatwave_Prediction → Advisory represents the warning path. Advisory_Stakeholder connects advisories and recipients as a many-to-many relationship.
experiments.evidence: Explore joined readings and inspect foreign keys. EER specializations are not verified by these queries.

experiments.title: Mapping EER to relations
experiments.application: Entities become separate tables; foreign keys connect them. Advisory_Stakeholder stores the advisory-recipient relationship.
experiments.evidence: The constraint inspector reports actual primary, foreign and unique keys; verify a composite or unique pair on the bridge table.

experiments.title: DDL and constraints
experiments.application: Tables, primary keys, foreign keys and CHECK constraints define the database structure and valid values.
experiments.evidence: Inspect deployed column definitions and constraints. The repository has no original schema migration, so constraints are reported from PostgreSQL rather than assumed.

experiments.title: DML and SQL retrieval
experiments.application: Existing Flask endpoints SELECT climate records. The temporary-table demo runs INSERT, UPDATE, SELECT and DELETE without changing climate records.
experiments.evidence: Run joined readings or the DML / transaction demo. Production insert/update/delete workflows are not implemented.

experiments.title: Aggregates, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, LIKE and HAVING
experiments.application: Summarize temperature by region, retain groups with enough readings, sort hottest regions first and search region names.
experiments.evidence: Run Regional statistics and Region name search; their SQL and returned rows demonstrate each clause.

experiments.title: Nested queries and views
experiments.application: A nested AVG query finds readings above the regional average. A reusable monthly view summarizes readings for historical analytics.
experiments.evidence: The subquery runs on existing tables. Monthly view requires backend/dbms_setup.sql; missing setup produces an explicit error.

experiments.title: Authorization: GRANT and REVOKE
experiments.application: Database privileges determine what the backend connection can read or modify.
experiments.evidence: Inspect effective table privileges for the connected role. GRANT/REVOKE examples are documented for an administrator; the browser does not change roles or permissions. RBAC/DAC/MAC are not claimed as fully implemented.

experiments.title: Indexing and query optimization
experiments.application: Indexes can accelerate sensor/date filters and foreign-key joins. PostgreSQL chooses the plan based on table size and selectivity.
experiments.evidence: Inspect existing indexes and run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on the joined-readings query. Optional indexes are in backend/dbms_setup.sql. A small table may still use a sequential scan.

experiments.title: ACID, concurrency and TCL
experiments.application: Read demonstrations use read-only transactions. The temporary-table demo uses BEGIN, SAVEPOINT, ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT and final ROLLBACK.
experiments.evidence: Live before/after rows verify rollback and savepoint behavior. COMMIT durability and simultaneous-session concurrency require the separate walkthrough in docs/DBMS_EXPERIMENTS.md.

queries.title: Joined sensor readings
queries.description: Trace a reading through its sensor, station and region. Dates are inclusive; results are bounded.
queries.sql:
SELECT sr.Reading_ID, sr.Reading_Time, sr.Temperature, sr.Humidity,
       sr.Heat_Index, ws.Station_Name, r.Region_Name
FROM Sensor_Reading sr
JOIN Sensor s ON sr.Sensor_ID = s.Sensor_ID
JOIN Weather_Station ws ON s.Station_ID = ws.Station_ID
JOIN Region r ON ws.Region_ID = r.Region_ID
WHERE (%(region)s IS NULL OR r.Region_Name = %(region)s)
  AND (%(start)s IS NULL OR sr.Reading_Time >= %(start)s::date)
  AND (%(end)s IS NULL OR sr.Reading_Time < %(end)s::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
ORDER BY sr.Reading_Time DESC, sr.Reading_ID DESC
LIMIT %(limit)s

queries.title: Regional statistics
queries.concepts: AVG · MIN · MAX · COUNT · GROUP BY · HAVING
queries.description: Summarize observed temperature and filter regions by minimum reading count.
queries.sql:
SELECT r.Region_Name, COUNT(*) AS reading_count,
       ROUND(AVG(sr.Temperature)::numeric, 2) AS avg_temperature,
       MIN(sr.Temperature) AS min_temperature, MAX(sr.Temperature) AS peak_temperature
FROM Region r JOIN Weather_Station ws ON ws.Region_ID = r.Region_ID
JOIN Sensor s ON s.Station_ID = ws.Station_ID
JOIN Sensor_Reading sr ON sr.Sensor_ID = s.Sensor_ID
WHERE (%(region)s IS NULL OR r.Region_Name = %(region)s)
GROUP BY r.Region_ID, r.Region_Name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= %(minimum)s
ORDER BY peak_temperature DESC NULLS LAST, r.Region_Name
LIMIT %(limit)s

queries.title: Region name search
queries.description: Search using SQL LIKE. Percent and underscore in the search text act as SQL wildcards.
queries.sql:
SELECT Region_ID, Region_Name, State, Climate_Zone, Population
FROM Region WHERE LOWER(Region_Name) LIKE LOWER(%(pattern)s)
ORDER BY Region_Name LIMIT %(limit)s

queries.title: Readings above regional average
queries.description: Compare each reading with the average across all sensors in its own region.
queries.sql:
SELECT r.Region_Name, ws.Station_Name, sr.Reading_Time, sr.Temperature
FROM Sensor_Reading sr JOIN Sensor s ON s.Sensor_ID = sr.Sensor_ID
JOIN Weather_Station ws ON ws.Station_ID = s.Station_ID
JOIN Region r ON r.Region_ID = ws.Region_ID
WHERE (%(region)s IS NULL OR r.Region_Name = %(region)s)
  AND sr.Temperature > (
    SELECT AVG(sr2.Temperature) FROM Sensor_Reading sr2
    JOIN Sensor s2 ON s2.Sensor_ID = sr2.Sensor_ID
    JOIN Weather_Station ws2 ON ws2.Station_ID = s2.Station_ID
    WHERE ws2.Region_ID = r.Region_ID)
ORDER BY sr.Temperature DESC, sr.Reading_ID LIMIT %(limit)s

queries.title: Monthly climate view
queries.description: Read a deployed SQL view. Install backend/dbms_setup.sql first if the view is missing.
queries.sql:
SELECT * FROM climate_lab_monthly_stats
WHERE (%(region)s IS NULL OR region_name = %(region)s)
ORDER BY month DESC, region_name LIMIT %(limit)s

queries.title: Deployed table columns
queries.description: Inspect actual column types, defaults and nullability in the public schema.
queries.sql:
SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, is_nullable, column_default
FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public'
ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position LIMIT %(limit)s

queries.title: Keys and constraints
queries.concepts: PRIMARY KEY · FOREIGN KEY · UNIQUE · CHECK
queries.description: Read the deployed constraint definitions, including the advisory-recipient relationship.
queries.sql:
SELECT c.relname AS table_name, con.conname AS constraint_name,
       pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) AS definition
FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public' ORDER BY c.relname, con.conname LIMIT %(limit)s

queries.title: Effective database privileges
queries.description: Show the current backend database role and its effective privileges. This checks access; it does not grant or revoke it.
queries.sql:
SELECT current_user AS database_role, tablename,
       has_table_privilege(current_user, format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename), 'SELECT') AS can_select,
       has_table_privilege(current_user, format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename), 'INSERT') AS can_insert,
       has_table_privilege(current_user, format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename), 'UPDATE') AS can_update,
       has_table_privilege(current_user, format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename), 'DELETE') AS can_delete
FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' ORDER BY tablename LIMIT %(limit)s

queries.title: Deployed indexes
queries.description: Inspect existing index definitions. Index presence alone does not prove a speed improvement.
queries.sql:
SELECT tablename, indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes
WHERE schemaname = 'public' ORDER BY tablename, indexname LIMIT %(limit)s

queries.title: Reading query execution plan
queries.description: Execute the bounded reading SELECT and inspect actual scan/join choices, timing and buffer usage.
queries.sql:
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON)
SELECT sr.Reading_ID, sr.Reading_Time, sr.Temperature, sr.Humidity,
       sr.Heat_Index, ws.Station_Name, r.Region_Name
FROM Sensor_Reading sr
JOIN Sensor s ON sr.Sensor_ID = s.Sensor_ID
JOIN Weather_Station ws ON s.Station_ID = ws.Station_ID
JOIN Region r ON ws.Region_ID = r.Region_ID
WHERE (%(region)s IS NULL OR r.Region_Name = %(region)s)
  AND (%(start)s IS NULL OR sr.Reading_Time >= %(start)s::date)
  AND (%(end)s IS NULL OR sr.Reading_Time < %(end)s::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
ORDER BY sr.Reading_Time DESC, sr.Reading_ID DESC
LIMIT %(limit)s

queries.title: Temporary DML / transaction demo
queries.description: Use a connection-local temporary table to show DML and partial rollback. The final rollback removes the entire demo; climate data is untouched.
